args.author: agent:long-lived-fly
args.body: 12 scenario modules exist and 0 of them measure anything like a lifespan: none. The scenarios are glide, current, temperature, depth, altitude, predator, grip and the rest -- every one of them a question asked of an organism at an age, not a question about how many ages it gets. The engine has growth tracks (ontogeny.json, for two teleosts) and no senescence model for anything. There is no mortality rate, no survival curve and no cause of death in this repository.

detail.searched_for: lifespan, senescence, longevity, mortality, ageing -- across sim-engine/ and the Lean law set

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
